OFFICE OF THE PRINCIPAL

Message from the Head-Teacher

Welcome to my official digital gateway. Since 12 February 2023, I have been serving as the Head-Teacher and Principal of Shitala Secondary School. My primary aim is to modernize pedagogy while preserving our native educational values. As an educator and General Secretary of the Principals Association of Nepal (PAN), I believe in leading through community trust, continuous professional development (CPD) for teachers, and structural educational transparency.
Laxman Shrestha
Head-Teacher & Principal

KEY INITIATIVES

Pioneering Financial Transparency & Digital Administration

Leadership is defined by accountability. In January 2024, our administration pioneered a comprehensive **Financial Transparency & Public Hearing Program** at Shitala Secondary School. By sharing audits, structural breakdowns, and local education spending publicly, we successfully set a new milestone for public school administration in Nepal.
🔍 Financial Audits

Complete structural school budgeting presented with feedback options from the community ward.

📣 Public Hearings

Regular interactive sessions between parents, school management committee, and town officials.

GLOBAL OUTLOOK

International Collaborations & Exchange Programs

Education must have globally responsive horizons. Under our current administrative tenure, Shitala Secondary School has fostered robust international connections:
🇯🇵 Japan-Nepal Student Exchange

Enabling cultural interactions, shared scientific workshops, and collaborative high school academic projects.

🇩🇪 Himalaya Friends, Germany

Sustained pedagogical partnerships, structural resources, and computer lab modernizations.

🇬🇧 Britannica Partnership & USEF Nepal

Digital educational textbook access and scholarship readiness resources for outstanding graduates.

🎓 KU School of Education (KUSE) Training

Continuous teacher refresher training and research methodologies with Kathmandu University experts.
